services.name: Lower Antelope Canyon Guided Hiking Tour

blurb: Guests take a guided hiking tour through Lower Antelope Canyon, descending five flights of stairs and hiking approximately 1.1 miles through narrow, sculpted sandstone passageways. Tours last about 60 to 90 minutes, with a total visit time of about 1.5 hours including check-in. The canyon is a sacred Navajo site with safety measures such as handrails on ladders and no bags allowed.
